🎮 Recommended Shader: Sildur’s Vibrant
For the best visual experience, it's recommended to use Sildur’s Vibrant Shader.
🔗 Download it [here](https://sildurs-shaders.github.io/)

💡 How to install the shader:
Download the shader ZIP file

Press Win + R, type:

%appdata%\.minecraft\shaderpacks
Paste the ZIP file in that folder (don’t unzip it)

Launch Minecraft with OptiFine

Go to Options → Video Settings → Shaders and select Sildur’s Vibrant

🎨 How to install the Resource Pack:
Press Win + R, type:

 
%appdata%\.minecraft\resourcepacks
Move the resource pack ZIP into that folder

Launch Minecraft, go to Options → Resource Packs, and activate it!

✅ Works on both cracked and premium Minecraft !

📦 What this Resource Pack changes:

GUI (Graphical Interface)

Realism & Block Textures
